title: Imagine Story Arc
description: Defines a narrative video that flows through multiple visual styles / LUT presets with thematic beats and story structure. Used to generate or assemble a coherent multi-style video from one or more base images.

base_prompt.description: The core subject / character / scene description that stays consistent. The style of each beat is layered on top.

continuity_notes.description: Extra instructions for keeping character, clothing, lighting logic, identity consistent across style changes.

narrative_beat.description: The story moment this beat represents (setup, inciting incident, rising action, crisis, climax, resolution, etc.)

prompt_add.description: Additional motion, camera, action, mood, or thematic instruction for this specific beat. Will be combined with base_prompt + style's own prompt.

transition.description: How to transition into this beat visually (e.g. slow cross dissolve, whip pan, match cut on color, style bleed)

ref_strategy.description: What to use as image reference for consistency when generating this beat's clip.

audio_notes.description: Suggestions for native Imagine audio or post: score, voiceover, SFX that follow the arc.

output_target.description: Where the final stitched or described video should live, e.g. stories/outputs/dusk-to-neon.mp4
